The following events took place in approximately '''15,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] are stripped of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and expelled from [[Yuuzhan'tar]]. They embark upon a journey to find a new homeworld.
*[[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] is finally considered a separate culture from [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].
*The [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]] encounter a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] colony, and soon join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
*[[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] join the Republic.
*The [[Aqualish Civil War]] occurs. {{Circa}}
*The [[Aqualish–Republic War]] begins and ends. {{Circa}}
*The [[Indecta Era]] ends.
*[[Republic Fleet Systems]] is founded. {{Circa}}<ref name="EGtVaV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
*The [[Hutt Cataclysms]] come to an end, leaving [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and other Hutt colonies lifeless wastes.
*The [[Hutt Empire]] collapses
*The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] escape from the destruction of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and move to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]] and [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] it into the new Hutt capital, Nal Hutta.
*The [[Evocii]] native to Nal Hutta/Evocar are evicted to the planet's fifth moon and are enslaved to build the cities of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
*The [[Senate Hall]] is constructed. {{Circa}}
[[File:YuuzhanVong_NEGAS.jpg|250px|thumb|Yuuzhan Vong fought in the Cremlevian War]]
